 Fulton County Registration and Elections Hold Election Day Meeting and Media Briefing 
 Fulton County Registration and Elections Hold Election Day Meeting and Media Briefing
 October 27, 2026 
 The Fulton County Board of Registration and Elections will hold a special General/Special Election Day meeting on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. at the Fulton County Elections Hub and Operations Center, located at 5600 Campbellton Fairburn Road in Union City, Georgia.
Additionally, a media briefing will be held immediately following the BRE Election Day Meeting. The planned briefing will assist in providing reporters and editors with updates regarding the election process.
Both the meeting and briefing will be available to watch live on FGTV .
